changed_benchmarks.stderr_policy: First two sources require empty stderr. Adapted pyperformance sources must emit exactly one finite nonnegative seconds line, retained raw but excluded from parity.

ir_comparison.command_template: PYSTACHY_HOME=OWN_CHECKOUT PYSTACHY_PATH=PREPARED_IMPORT_PATH OWN_COMPILER MODE CASE -o OUTPUT
ir_comparison.runtime_mode: rt for runtime.py and rtmode_*.py; ir otherwise
ir_comparison.normalization: Replace only both exact absolute checkout home prefixes in both outputs with one common prefix of the same byte length; no other normalization.

structural_review.method: Validate operands, guards, branch targets, callback unwind targets and exception-slot/handler transfer; invert only validated replacement sequences; compare whole functions after generated SSA/block identifier renaming. Static audit, not a formal proof.

limitations: Focused JIT/AOT and selected GC/optimization variants do not replace full verification.
Changed benchmark checks use the same adapted source in each runtime; they do not qualify the pristine upstream pyperformance suite.
This file contains correctness and static-IR evidence only; timing results are separate.
